codelines.name: gotransit
codelines.reason: This repo implements the Go-Checkout page's Email and Confirm Email fields, including the exact case-sensitive comparison the ticket describes.
codelines.evidence: src/components/pages/CheckoutPage/CheckoutForm.tsx line ~305: `validate: (value: string) => { if (email && value && value !== email) { return t("TRM774"); } }` — a case-sensitive `!==` comparison between `email` and `confirmEmail`

facts.text: Tests run with `jest` (`npm run test`); a spec file already exists for this exact form at `src/components/pages/CheckoutPage/__tests__/CheckoutForm.spec.tsx`, so a fix here should extend that file rather than create a new one.

A pre-commit hook enforces both `npx lint-staged` and a branch-name pattern `^(feature|bugfix|tech|release|hotfix)\/[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+(\/[a-z0-9-]+)?$` — commits on a non-conforming branch name are rejected.
